title: AndroDR Rule Author Decision Manifest
description: Schema for the 'decisions' array returned by update-rules-author.

rule_id.description: Rule ID the decision applies to, or null for pre-creation decisions (skip, telemetry_gap).

field.description: Field name the decision applies to, 'rule_creation' for meta-decisions, or 'ioc_data' for IOC-level decisions.

type.description: Decision type. Omitted for generic ambiguity flags (severity, IOC breadth, behavioral borderline).

chosen.description: The choice the Rule Author made.

reasoning.description: Why the chosen option was picked over the alternative.

missing_field.description: Only present for type=telemetry_gap. The taxonomy field that would have been needed.

suggested_service.description: Only present for type=telemetry_gap. The logsource service the missing field should belong to.
